items.explanation: は presents 交番 as the theme of the sentence: we are saying where the police box is located.

items.jp: 明日は休みです だから遊びに行きます

translation.pt-BR: Amanhã é folga, então vou sair pra me divertir.
translation.en: Tomorrow's my day off, so I'm going to go out and have fun.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は marks 明日 as the subject: 'as for tomorrow…'. It is common with time expressions at the start of the sentence.

items.jp: 彼は頭がいいしスポーツも上手だ

translation.pt-BR: Ele é inteligente e ainda manda bem nos esportes.
translation.en: He's smart and good at sports on top of it.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は marks 彼 ('he') as the general topic being talked about.
tokens: subject of the embedded clause (頭がいい)

items.jp: この道具はとても便利です

translation.pt-BR: Esta ferramenta é muito prática.
translation.en: This tool is very handy.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は marks この道具 as the theme of the sentence: 'as for this tool...'.

items.jp: この間の映画は面白かった

translation.pt-BR: O filme do outro dia foi muito bom.
translation.en: The movie from the other day was really good.

items.label: marks the topic of the sentence
items.explanation: は highlights この間の映画 as what is being commented on: it was interesting.

items.jp: 彼は頭がいいです それに優しいです

translation.pt-BR: Ele é inteligente e, além disso, é gentil.
translation.en: He's smart, and on top of that he's kind.

items.label: marks the topic
items.explanation: は marks 彼 (he) as the general topic of the sentence; everything that follows describes this 'he'.
tokens: subject (within the expression 頭がいい)

items.jp: 勉強した しかしテストは難しかった

translation.pt-BR: Estudei, mas a prova estava difícil.
translation.en: I studied, but the test was hard.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は marks テスト ("the test") as the topic of the second clause: "as for the test, it was difficult".

items.jp: 子どもはとても眠そうな顔をしています

translation.pt-BR: A criança está com uma cara de muito sono.
translation.en: The child looks really sleepy.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は marks 子ども ('the child') as the topic: it is the child whose appearance we are describing.

items.jp: 母はすぐに怒る

translation.pt-BR: Minha mãe se irrita fácil.
translation.en: My mom gets irritated easily.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は presents 母 as the topic of the sentence: 'speaking of mother,...'. In pt-BR this simply becomes the subject ('my mother').

items.jp: 医者は父にお酒をやめるように言った

translation.pt-BR: O médico disse pro meu pai parar de beber.
translation.en: The doctor told my father to stop drinking.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は marks 医者 as the topic, the one who says something in the sentence.
tokens: target of the order (the one being told)
core of the ように construction
auxiliary of the ように construction

items.jp: 弟は去年より背がのびた

translation.pt-BR: Meu irmão mais novo cresceu desde o ano passado.
translation.en: My younger brother has grown since last year.

items.label: topic marker
items.explanation: は presents 弟 as the topic: it is about the younger brother that one speaks.
